CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Ethereal, CardKeyword.Exhaust }` (Apparition.cs:14-18) == `is_ethereal = True` + `exhausts = True` at base.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Ancient, TargetType.Self)` (Apparition.cs:24-27) == cost 1 / SKILL / ANCIENT / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<IntangiblePower>(1m)` (Apparition.cs:22) == `_intangible = 1`, read back as `base.DynamicVars["IntangiblePower"].BaseValue` at the apply site (Apparition.cs:32).

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<IntangiblePower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["IntangiblePower"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Apparition.cs:32) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, IntangiblePower, self._intangible, applier=ctx.player)`. Self-target, self-applier, amount 1. Presentation, folded in: Apparition.cs:31 runs CreatureCmd.TriggerAnim("Cast") first, and ExtraHoverTips (line 20) is hover-tip wiring; neither has a sim counterpart and neither is in scope.

OnUpgrade.issue: The UPGRADE is faithful; the DOWNGRADE is not. `RemoveKeyword(CardKeyword.Ethereal)` (Apparition.cs:37) maps to `self.is_ethereal = False`, correct at level 1. But `Card.downgrade` (cards/base.py:150-165) rebuilds by re-running `_init_vars`, and `ApparitionCard._init_vars` (apparition.py:24-26) sets only `_energy_cost` and `_intangible` -- it never re-seeds `is_ethereal` -- so the instance attribute written by `_on_upgrade` survives and the downgraded card stays NON-Ethereal. C# `DowngradeInternal` rebuilds the keyword set from canonical (`_keywords = cardModel.GetKeywordsWithSources(KeywordSources.Local).ToHashSet()`, CardModel.cs:2143), restoring Ethereal. Observable and strictly player-favourable in the sim: in the game a downgraded Apparition exhausts itself at end of turn if unplayed; in the sim it is kept. EXECUTED: `py audit/tools/card_probes.py downgrade` prints `apparition: is_ethereal: True -> False` (5 of 203 sim cards affected). LIVE -- `downgrade()` is reachable from `events/reflections.py:40`, `events/welcome_to_wongos.py:90` (both registered in `events/__init__.py`) and `powers.py:3171` (DampenPower). Apparition itself is reachable: it is the Ancient card granted by Distinguished Cape (apparition.py:13-14). RATIONALE CITES THIRD FILES (rule 7): cards/base.py, CardModel.cs and the two event modules are not hashed by this record.
